title.narrative: UNESCO Recommendation on OER: Meeting Emerging Challenges

description.narrative: This project aims to: - Reinforce the OER Dynamic Coalition activities to support information sharing and collaboration amongst its members and implement activities in priority areas identified in the 1st consolidated report on the implementation of the Recommendation on OER. - Establish an observatory on OER to ensure that OER is identifying trends and major areas of discussion, and to explore successful scenarios through similar challenges, for decision makers in Governments and Institutions. - Support the organization the 3rd UNESCO World OER Congress ‘Digital Public Goods: Open Solutions for Inclusive Access to Knowledge’ which will identify how this UN Normative instrument can effectively contribute to the UN Secretary General’s Road Map for Digital Cooperation, Commitment 7 of ‘Our Common Agenda’: to “Improve of digital cooperation” and contribute to the Global Digital Compact.
